title: Enforce live procurement permission and owning customer scope on purchase order workflows
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve current enabled identity and existing purchase-order menu for every core controller list/detail/export/options/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete endpoint before counts, numbers or writes. Scope using explicit owning customer and authoritative owning sales-order customer; restricted users cannot access unowned/unlinked procurement without authoritative customer ownership, while authorized unrestricted procurement-for-stock remains usable. Preserve supplier/currency/unit commercial semantics and existing exports; no new grants or fabricated sales links.

Validate stored and proposed ownership/source before assigning fields or replacing details. Serialize source-linked ownership changes and inherited state transitions with compatible sales-order then purchase-order locks/transaction; denied edits preserve totals/details/audit. Keep ERP346 authoritative snapshots and ERP345 receipt/payment cancellation guards, disallow approval race with invalidated source. Actual SQL verifies own/foreign/legacy-unowned access, revoked menu, disabled identity, export denial, atomic failed edit and two-connection state race. Update only legitimate authorized existing fixtures; no production operations or finance/stock posting.
